LOCAL LEGAL SERVICES

Antigonish & county communities

Legal services from Kostyantyn Mykhalchenko for clients in this region. Appointments in English, Ukrainian and Russian.

The local picture

Antigonish’s Main Street courthouse opens for scheduled Supreme Court matters, while the James Street location provides court administration. Check which address applies before attending or delivering paperwork.

Prepare for the conversation

For a rental, family or civil matter, keep a copy of the original agreement rather than only recent messages. If a move or change in living arrangements is approaching, explain the timing so the legal questions can be addressed in context.

Arrange your appointment

The practice is based in Halifax and welcomes enquiries from throughout Nova Scotia. Include your community, the practice area and any deadlines. Availability and the scope of representation are confirmed after an initial conversation and conflict check.
